# vendor/site-health — GENERATED

The site-health package (crawl, canonicals, redirects, internal links, accessibility
tree, link topics, doorway ratio, granularity floor, Wikidata) and the GA + SC geo
vocabulary, copied from the private `internal-ai-scripts` toolkit by
`scripts/site-health/vendor.mjs roden` so CI can run
`node vendor/site-health/site-health.mjs --repo . [--base <url>]` without toolkit
access. Never edit here: change the toolkit and re-vendor. `vendor.mjs roden --check`
fails when these drift. Options live under `siteHealth` in config.overlay.json.
